name: Collection-ledger completion
summary: A durable collection ledger converts rare acquisition into visible long-term progress without claiming that recorded completion improves the acquisition odds.
player_action: The player discovers an eligible item and later inspects category and total completion.
system_response: The system records the stable item identity once, updates category totals, and preserves provenance across sessions.

conflicts_with: displayed slots that do not correspond to obtainable records

failure_modes: Owned eligible items are missing from the ledger.
Counts change without a content or correction event.
The ledger implies increased odds that do not exist.
accessibility: Expose category and total progress with text as well as icons.
Mark unknown, unobtainable, and retired states distinctly.

smallest_playable_test.setup: Ten eligible items across two categories, duplicates, retroactive ownership, one retired item, and save migration.
smallest_playable_test.retain_if: Every eligible discovery records once and totals remain reproducible after reload and migration.
smallest_playable_test.revise_if: State is correct but unknown or retired slots mislead players.
smallest_playable_test.reject_if: Completion totals cannot be regenerated from the item registry and discovery state.

evidence.claim: An archived official Old School RuneScape update records collection-log slot-count discrepancies and a hotfix restoring expected totals.
evidence.notes: Supports total consistency as a player-visible contract; it does not establish drop causality.
